deploy-bot: [ALERT] Cron job model-refresh-nightly failed on host inference-node-3 at 2025-11-12T04:00Z
Logs:
ERROR: kv-compact failed: sqlite3 database is locked
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/refresh.py", line 212, in run_refresh
    compact_db()
sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked

maya: FYI seeing repeated lock errors since last deploy, looks like compact overlaps with backup job.
akshay: @maya can you paste the last successful commit/sha for the refresh image? I want to bisect.
maya: image sha: 0a7c9d1 (deployed 2025-11-11 23:40 UTC)
jen: I'm +1 to rerun manually after disabling backup. Can someone disable backup job in infra? @lia?
lia: disabling backup for today, done :white_check_mark:
maya: requeued manual run: `kubectl -n infra create job --from=cronjob/model-refresh-nightly model-refresh-manual-174812` 
deploy-bot: Job model-refresh-manual-174812 started on inference-node-2
akshay: while it's running, can we check if the migration added WAL mode? WAL would prevent locks. grep in docker image: `sqlite3 --version` and check PR #4127
maya: the image has `PR #4127` which introduced compact concurrency, maybe regression.
jen: if rerun fails, please capture `lsof` and `ps aux` on node.
lia: manual run finished: exit 1. new logs:
```
INFO: starting compact
sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked
PID 1023 /usr/bin/python3 holding FD 8
``` 
maya: PID 1023 is `backup-runner` which I thought we disabled. investigating.
akshay: can someone run `kubectl exec -n infra inference-node-2 -- lsof -p 1023` and paste owner? I suspect systemd timer restarted it.
lia: `backup-runner` is a systemd unit on node, infra didn't stop it. Stopping now.
lia: stopped backup-runner and killed pid 1023 :boom:
maya: restarted manual job: `kubectl -n infra create job --from=cronjob/model-refresh-nightly model-refresh-manual-174812-2`
deploy-bot: Job model-refresh-manual-174812-2 started on inference-node-3
deploy-bot: Job completed successfully: exit 0
maya: success! model sets refreshed. :tada:
jen: great, but we should make backup-reschedule idempotent to avoid overlap. filing an issue.
akshay: also I bisected PRs and found PR #4127 caused a regression in compact logic. opening PR to revert the change and add test.
maya: opening incident ticket INC-2025-483 and linking PRs
lia: re-enabled backup job and scheduled offset +10m to avoid overlap
jen: nice coordination, please add postmortem note to eng-ml channel and tag oncall
maya: will write a short summary and assign follow-ups
sre-bot: Incident INC-2025-483 created and assigned to maya, severity: P2
maya: thanks everyone
